Your team is well-balanced this week and projects 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. He is a clear captain choice, though with only an 8% floor for single digits there is some risk; Salah sits close behind at 7.9 if you want to hedge. The three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City give you strong representation where it matters, though it concentrates your upside in a small number of clubs.

The suggested transfer of Wood to Watkins costs nothing this week and gains 6.4 over the next five gameweeks. That is straightforward value with no points hit to absorb. You have one free transfer and £0.5m in the bank, so the move is possible.

Muniz on the bench carries a 50% chance of not playing, which limits his reliability as cover, but he is bench-deep enough that this does not demand a precaution now. Your starting eleven and bench project 71.5 combined this gameweek, which is solid.

Make the transfer when you are ready. Nothing in this week's setup demands urgency.

Your eleven is tight and balanced. Haaland at the armband is marginally ahead of Salah—he's 0.3 clear—with a quarter chance of doubling digits this week, though he carries real downside risk too. The captain call is sound but not certain.

You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. That's concentration, but these are your best assets and it hasn't left you light elsewhere.

The Wood-to-Watkins switch costs nothing this week and gains 6.4 across the next five gameweeks. It's a free transfer, so you keep your one in reserve.

Muniz on the bench is at 50% to play. His projection is low enough that even if he starts you won't regret having him there, but if he's out you'll have no cover at all. The bench projects 10.7, with Mykolenko the only real contributor at 3.1, so you're thin on the sideline. There's no urgent fix, but if you see a cheap enabler or a rise opportunity before kickoff, this is where to look.

Your eleven is well-set for this gameweek at 60.8, rising to 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. He sits 0.3 clear of Salah and carries genuine upside — a 25% chance of 10+ against a notable downside of 8% for 2 or fewer. The captain choice is tight but the model has it.

You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. That concentration is worth noting, though all six are among your highest scorers. Your bench offers little: Mykolenko at 3.1 is the best of it, and Muniz is flagged at 50% to play anyway.

The model recommends Wood out for Watkins. This nets 6.4 across the next five gameweeks with no points hit. You have the transfer free, so you can make it without cost beyond opportunity — the question is whether you want to lock in the move now or wait to see Wood's output this week.

As things stand, take the week as it is. Haaland has the armband, your backline is solid, and Salah and Saka give you good cover. The Watkins move is worth doing if you're comfortable with it, but this gameweek doesn't hang on it.
